F024.summary: App layout with collapsible sidebar, project selector, navigation links, user menu, and responsive design

Sidebar collapses/expands.detail: AppSidebar uses sidebarCollapsed from Zustand store. Toggles between w-16 and w-64. Transition animation with duration-300.

Navigation links work.detail: NavLinks component imported and rendered. Uses TanStack Router navigation.

Project selector dropdown.detail: ProjectSelector component rendered at top of sidebar. Accepts collapsed prop for compact mode.

Responsive on resize.detail: Mobile: absolute overlay with backdrop (z-50). Desktop: relative positioning. Uses md: breakpoint for responsive layout.

F025.summary: Kanban board with 5 columns, drag-drop via @dnd-kit, status transition validation, and feature cards

Columns for each status.detail: 5 columns: backlog, pending, in_progress, waiting_approval, verified. Failed status excluded from board (intentional). Uses FEATURE_VALID_TRANSITIONS for drag-drop validation.

Drag-drop with dnd-kit.detail: DndContext with PointerSensor and KeyboardSensor. DragOverlay for visual feedback. closestCenter collision detection. Validates transitions before allowing drop.

Status change on drop.detail: onDragEnd validates transition against FEATURE_VALID_TRANSITIONS before calling onStatusChange callback. Shows toast on invalid transitions.

Visual feedback.detail: Color-coded columns (neutral/yellow/blue/purple/green). DragOverlay shows card during drag. isOver highlighting on columns.

F026.summary: Feature card with id, title, priority badge, size indicator, dependency count, and sortable drag support

Shows id and title.detail: KanbanCard renders feature.id and feature.title. Uses Card component with CardHeader/CardTitle.

Priority badge.detail: getPriorityLevel maps numeric priority to high/medium/low labels. Color-coded badges (red/yellow/neutral).

Size indicator.detail: estimatedSize shown as badge if present.

Dependency count.detail: dependencies array rendered with GitBranch icon for dependency count.

F027.summary: Slide-out Sheet panel with feature details, edit mode, status transitions, and execution controls

Slide-out panel.detail: Uses shadcn Sheet component with SheetContent. Controlled via open/onOpenChange props.

Shows all fields.detail: Loads feature by ID via orpc query. Shows title, description, acceptance criteria, status, model/thinking/planning settings, and execution controls.

Edit capability.detail: isEditing state toggles between view and edit modes. Editable title and description fields. Uses mutation for updates.

Action buttons.detail: Start/Stop execution dialogs (Play/Square icons). Status transition buttons. Link to feature detail page.

F028.summary: Feature create/edit form using TanStack Form with Zod validation, category/phase/size selects, and AC array

TanStack Form integration.detail: useForm from @tanstack/react-form. Form fields for title, category, description, phase, priority, estimatedSize, acceptanceCriteria.

Zod validation.detail: Uses Zod schema imported from @nomos-ai/types for validation. Constants from FEATURE_CATEGORIES, FEATURE_PHASES, ESTIMATED_SIZE.

Acceptance criteria array.detail: AC field allows adding/removing criteria items.

Create and edit modes.detail: Optional feature prop — if provided, form is in edit mode. Uses mutation for create/update via oRPC.

F029.summary: Kanban column header with count, actions dropdown, and collapse/expand toggle

Count updates on change.detail: features.length displayed next to column title. Updates reactively as features array changes.

Actions menu works.detail: DropdownMenu with MoreHorizontal trigger. DropdownMenuContent with items.

Collapse hides cards.detail: isCollapsed from Zustand store (collapsedColumns[status]). toggleColumnCollapsed action. ChevronDown icon for visual indicator.

Visual feedback.detail: Color-coded header (color prop). isOver state from useDroppable for drag highlight. SortableContext with verticalListSortingStrategy.

F030.summary: Filter bar with search, category dropdown, phase dropdown, and URL-persisted filter state

Search filters by title.detail: Input field with placeholder 'Search by title...'. Filters features where title includes search string (case-insensitive).

Category dropdown works.detail: Select component with FEATURE_CATEGORIES from @nomos-ai/types. Filters features by category match.

Phase dropdown works.detail: Select component with FEATURE_PHASES from @nomos-ai/types. Filters features by phase match.

Filters persist in URL.detail: Route.useSearch() reads search params. Filter changes update URL via navigate with ...searchParams spread. Params: search, category, phase.
